name: Nosto
tagline: Nosto is an AI-powered commerce experience platform that personalises every touchpoint of the online shopping journey — product recommendations, search results, content, and pop-ups — based on individual shopper behaviour. Over 2,500 retailers use it to increase conversion rates and average order values.
